gate.recall: section sample reports classification misses; rule recall is not estimated

limitations: Replay covers one repository under a fixed kind profile, not original historical configurations.
Agent judgments are not human labels.
Zero diagnostics imply unavailable precision, not perfect precision.
noise_definition: A block is one real Markdown path change with at least one false-positive diagnostic after checking, whether newly introduced or persistent. Each change counts once per rule; all clean changes remain in the denominator. Newly introduced diagnostics are reported separately.
